description: RISC Software publishes trained traffic-sign detection and classification models accompanying the Austrian Highway Traffic Sign Dataset. Python notebooks show image preparation, augmentation, prediction and evaluation, with pretrained weights and precomputed results stored in separate repository directories. The benchmark uses Austrian highway images acquired in 2014 and annotated in 2020–2021. GitHub supplies the model package for free under Apache 2.0; the source dataset has separate ASFINAG access terms. These statistical models can supply perception components or benchmark observation errors in driving simulations. Their performance outside Austrian signs and acquisition conditions is uncertain, and the notebooks do not cover model training itself. No code or weights were executed. No directly related catalogue model was identified.
name: ATSD traffic-sign baseline models and tools
